text: MW_MODE=false function MW_Dest(P,inv,c,it) local ov=inv:GetOverflowContainer() local ovi=ov and ov.inst local pot,best,bs for k in pairs(inv:GetOpenContainers()) do local r=k.replica.container if r and k~=P and k~=ovi and not (r.IsReadOnlyContainer and r:IsReadOnlyContainer()) then if k.prefab:find("cookpot") then pot=k elseif r:CanTakeItemInSlot(it) then local sc=(k.prefab=="icebox" or k.prefab=="saltbox") and 2 or 1 for _,v in pairs(r:GetItems()) do if v.prefab==it.prefab then sc=3 end end if not bs or sc>bs then best,bs=k,sc end end end end if MW_MODE=="top" then if c.inst==pot then return P,false end if pot and pot.replica.container:CanTakeItemInSlot(it) then return pot,true end return nil end if c==inv or c==ov then return best,false end return P,false end --M

text: function MW_Move(s) local P=ThePlayer local inv=P.replica.inventory local c,n=s.container,s.num local it=c:GetItemInSlot(n) if not it then return end local d,one=MW_Dest(P,inv,c,it) if not d or d==c.inst then TheFocalPoint.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/HUD/click_negative") return end local dm=P.HUD.controls.inv:GetDropMode() local st=it.replica.stackable local z=st and st:StackSize() or 1 if one or dm==DROP_MODES.ONE then c:MoveItemFromCountOfSlot(n,d,1) elseif dm==DROP_MODES.HALF then c:MoveItemFromCountOfSlot(n,d,math.max(1,math.floor(z/2))) else c:MoveItemFromAllOfSlot(n,d) end TheFocalPoint.SoundEmitter:PlaySound("dontstarve/HUD/click_object") end --M

text: function MW_Open(m) local P=ThePlayer local inv=P.replica.inventory local ov=inv:GetOverflowContainer() local ovi=ov and ov.inst for k in pairs(inv:GetOpenContainers()) do if k~=P and k~=ovi and k.replica.container and (k.prefab:find("cookpot")~=nil)==(m=="top") then return true end end return false end local I=require("widgets/invslot") I.OrigTE=I.OrigTE or I.OnTouchEnd I.OrigDT=I.OrigDT or I.OnDoubleTap I.OnTouchEnd=function(s,id,x,y) if MW_MODE and s.touchID==id and s.tile and s.tile.item and ThePlayer.replica.inventory:GetActiveItem()==nil then s.touchID=nil local ok,e=pcall(MW_Move,s) if not ok then Networking_SystemMessage("MW move: "..tostring(e)) end return end return I.OrigTE(s,id,x,y) end I.OnDoubleTap=function(s,x,y) if MW_MODE then return true end return I.OrigDT(s,x,y) end --M

text: local P=ThePlayer for _,r in ipairs(P.HUD.controls.networkchatqueue.widget_rows) do if r.cb then r.cb:Kill() r.cb=nil end end local C=require"screens/chatinputscreen" if not C.tl then C.tl=C.OnBecomeActive C.OnBecomeActive=function(s,...) C.tl(s,...) for _,r in ipairs(s.networkchatqueue.widget_rows) do if not r.cb then local b=r.root:AddChild(require"widgets/imagebutton"()) r.cb=b b:SetImageNormalColour(0,0,0,0) b:SetImageFocusColour(0,0,0,0) b:ForceImageSize(690,32) b:SetPosition(305,0) b:SetOnClick(function() local d=ChatHistory:GetChatMessageAtIndex(r.history_index) local m=d and d.message local V=rawget(_G,"VisitURL") if m and V then pcall(V,"https://translate.google.com/?sl=auto&tl=en&op=translate&text="..m:gsub("[^%w]",function(c) return("%%%02X"):format(c:byte()) end),true) else pcall(function() P.components.talker:Say(m and"no VisitURL"or"no msg",1) end) end end) end end end end --M
label: 14 (Local) Chatscreen Tap to Translate | Works best if you make your default browser float over the game before tapping any chat line to translate, else the browser will go fullscreen

text: local P=ThePlayer local T=P.HUD.controls.right_root if T.tt then T.tt:Kill() end if T.ta then T.ta:Cancel() end local W,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() local w=T:GetWorldPosition() local k=T:GetWorldScale().x local t=T:AddChild(require"widgets/text"(TALKINGFONT,50,"--")) T.tt=t t:SetPosition((W*0.9625-w.x)/k,(H*0.7963-w.y)/k) T.ta=P:DoPeriodicTask(1,function() local v for _,f in ipairs{function() return P:GetTemperature() end,function() local c=P.player_classified.currenttemperature return type(c)=="number" and c or c:value() end,function() return P.replica.temperature:GetCurrent() end} do local o,x=pcall(f) if o and type(x)=="number" then v=x break end end if v then local c=v<=0 and{.5,.8,1}or v>=70 and{1,.4,.4}or{1,1,1} t:SetString(math.floor(v+.5).."\194\176") t:SetColour(c[1],c[2],c[3],1) else t:SetString("n/a") end end,0) --M
label: 15. (Local) Player Temperature

text: local P=ThePlayer local T=P.HUD.controls.right_root if T.gr then T.gr:Kill() end local R=require local g=T:AddChild(R"widgets/widget"("g")) T.gr=g local D={} T.dd=D local M=TheWorld.Map local k=T:GetWorldScale().x for n=0,8 do local d=g:AddChild(R"widgets/imagebutton"("images/global.xml","square.tex")) d:ForceImageSize(34/k,34/k) d:SetImageNormalColour(.2,1,.2,.85) d:SetOnClick(function() if T.tp then T.tp(d.wx,d.wz) end end) D[n]=d end g.OnUpdate=function() pcall(function() local h=P.replica.inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS) local x,_,z=P.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local c,_,y=M:GetTileCenterPoint(x,0,z) if not(h and h.prefab:find("hoe") and M:IsFarmableSoilAtPoint(c,0,y)) then g:Hide() return end g:Show() local w=T:GetWorldPosition() for n=0,8 do local a,b=c+(n%3-1)*4/3,y+((n-n%3)/3-1)*4/3 local X,Y=TheSim:GetScreenPos(a,0,b) local d=D[n] d.wx=a d.wz=b d:Show() d:SetPosition((X-w.x)/k,(Y-w.y)/k) end end) end g:StartUpdating() --M
label: 15.1 (Local) Farm Tiller (1/3)

text: local P=ThePlayer local T=P.HUD.controls.right_root T.tp=function(x,z) local c=P.components.playercontroller if not c then return end local h=P.replica.inventory:GetEquippedItem(EQUIPSLOTS.HANDS) if not h then return end local a=P.components.playeractionpicker local p=Vector3(x,0,z) local t=(a:GetPointActions(p,h,true)or{})[1] if not(t and t.action) then return end local C=t.action local l,X,Z=c:GetPlatformRelativePosition(x,z) local m=c:EncodeControlMods() c.remote_controls[CONTROL_SECONDARY]=0 SendRPCToServer(RPC.RightClick,C.code,X,Z,nil,nil,m,C.canforce,C.mod_name,l,l~=nil) end Networking_SystemMessage("tp rmb") --M
label: 15.2 (Local) Farm Tiller (2/3)

text: local P=ThePlayer local T=P.HUD.controls.right_root local g=T.gr if not g.av then g.av=1 local o=g.OnUpdate g.OnUpdate=function() o() pcall(function() local x,_,z=P.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local A,B=TheSim:GetScreenPos(x,0,z) local _,Y=TheSim:GetScreenPos(x,1,z) local u=Y-B for _,d in pairs(T.dd) do if d.shown then local X,V=TheSim:GetScreenPos(d.wx,0,d.wz) if math.abs(X-A)<.6*u and V>B-.3*u and V<B+2*u then d:Hide() end end end end) end end --M
